card.title: Batch trial facial oil fix
card.conceptSummary: Show the raw lab workflow and trial-and-error process of testing a new facial oil formulation.
card.audience: Skincare enthusiasts looking for honest ingredient proof
card.viewerTakeaway: Understanding that real formulation takes multiple iterations.
overallProductionNotes: Keep lighting neutral daylight without warm filters
Focus camera macro lens on liquid texture transition

steps.action: Hold up pipette with cloudy mixture to camera light
steps.spokenLine: We had to throw away four batches before this worked.
steps.shot: Close-up of glass pipette with liquid

steps.action: Pour oil into beaker and stir slowly with glass rod
steps.spokenLine: The vitamin C kept separating from the oil layer.

steps.goal: Show visual texture proof of stable formula
steps.action: Drop finished clear oil onto wrist and blend into skin
steps.spokenLine: Adding squalane stabilized the blend instantly.
steps.shot: Macro shot of oil texture absorbing into skin

steps.goal: Provide saveable formula tip for viewers
steps.action: Cap the dark amber glass dropper bottle firmly
steps.spokenLine: Check the label for squalane if your facial oil feels heavy.
steps.shot: Medium shot capping bottle on linen surface
